newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GORILLA MAX'S ASSAILANT ESCAPES FROM PRISON.
newsitem.headline: GORILLA MAX'S ASSAILANT ESCAPES FROM PRISON.

text.p: The suspected robber who shot South Africa's favourite crime-buster, Max, the African lowland gorilla, escaped from prison on Friday, police said.

A police spokesman said Isaac Mofokeng and one of his two cellmates was freed from a policestation lockup by someone who climbed onto the roof, cut a hole through a mesh cover and lowered knotted blankets to the two men.
Mofokeng was missed when police arrived to escort him to court to face unrelated rape charges.
Mofokeng was mauled recently when he jumped into Max's enclosure at the Johannesburg zoo while fleeing police called to a nearby home to arrest a burglar.
He shot Max three times when the animal rushed forward to protect his mate, Lisa, but his fire was not enough to stop the gorilla from biting him and one of two policemen who followed.
The second policeman took a gorilla-sized punch from Max before Mofokeng was arrested and Max was taken to the nearest hospital for treatment.
Mofokeng later apologised to Max, who has become a cult figure in crime-ridden South Africa.
